request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with project funding later transferred to a Project-Specific Smart Contract; vendor named Teragone in the disclosure section.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continued development and Intersect budget administration using Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ada, consisting of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Mithril is described as using stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way, allowing nodes and applications to verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal claims Mithril reduces slow full-node synchronization and centralized light-client trust assumptions by enabling faster, verifiable access to blockchain state.
The proposal claims Mithril is fully aligned with Infrastructure & Research Excellence and Adoption & Utility, and partially aligned with Community & Ecosystem Growth.
The proposal claims it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was therefore advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal claims the requested withdrawal does not, at submission time, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The proposal states audit and oversight costs are included in overhead, with independent oversight through Intersect and technically capable third parties, including reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The proposal states Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs, while having worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.

The proposal states Intersect will use a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with specified addresses, role thresholds, and an Oversight Committee consisting of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.
The proposal states a dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for community auditing and on-chain tracking of the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol work and Intersect administration, gives a high-level rationale for Mithril's infrastructure benefits, lists budget totals and smart-contract custody controls, and references external sources for Hydra voting, audited results, smart contract documentation, audits, and dashboard tracking, but it does not include a detailed milestone schedule, complete feasibility analysis, alternatives analysis, risk analysis, or failure-mode analysis.
